site.title: UseEasyTool
site.description: A collection of useful online tools for developers and designers.

welcome_desc: A comprehensive collection of free tools for developers, designers, and everyone. No installation required.
tool_base64_desc: Free online Base64 encoder and decoder. Convert text to Base64 and back with UTF-8 support. No data sent to server.
tool_url_desc: Free online URL encoder and decoder. Encode or decode URL components, query strings, and special characters instantly in your browser.
tool_json_yaml_desc: Free online JSON to YAML converter. Transform JSON data to YAML and vice versa with syntax validation and formatting support.
tool_number_base_desc: Free online number base converter. Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal formats with instant results.
tool_unit_desc: Free online unit converter. Convert length, weight, temperature, volume, area, speed, and more between metric and imperial units.
tool_timestamp_desc: Free online Unix timestamp converter. Convert timestamps to human-readable dates and times, with support for multiple date formats and timezones.
tool_html_entities_desc: Free online HTML entity encoder and decoder. Convert special characters to HTML entities and back for safe web content embedding.
tool_markdown_html_desc: Free online Markdown to HTML converter. Transform Markdown text into clean HTML code with live preview and copy-to-clipboard support.
tool_calculator_standard_desc: Free online standard calculator. Perform basic arithmetic operations including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division with a clean interface.
tool_calculator_scientific_desc: Free online scientific calculator. Compute advanced math functions including trigonometry, logarithms, exponents, roots, and constants like pi.
tool_loan_desc: Free online loan calculator. Calculate monthly payments, total interest, and amortization schedules for mortgages, auto loans, and personal loans.
tool_bmi_desc: Free online BMI calculator. Calculate your Body Mass Index instantly with health category classification and weight range recommendations.
tool_age_desc: Free online age calculator. Calculate your exact age in years, months, and days from your birth date with detailed breakdown.
tool_password_strength_desc: Free online password strength checker. Analyze password security with entropy scoring, weakness detection, and improvement suggestions.
tool_image_compress_desc: Free online image compressor. Reduce image file size without noticeable quality loss. Supports JPG, PNG, WebP, and GIF with batch processing.
tool_image_format_desc: Free online image format converter. Convert images between PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, and BMP formats with adjustable quality settings.
tool_image_base64_desc: Free online image to Base64 converter. Encode images to Base64 data URIs for embedding in HTML and CSS, or decode Base64 back to images.
tool_image_crop_desc: Free online image crop and rotate tool. Crop images to custom aspect ratios and rotate or flip them with drag-and-drop ease.
tool_image_filters_desc: Free online image filter editor. Apply brightness, contrast, saturation, blur, grayscale, sepia, and other visual effects to your images.
tool_screenshot_desc: Free online screenshot and annotation tool. Capture webpage screenshots with custom dimensions and add text, arrows, and shapes.
tool_color_picker_desc: Free online color palette extractor. Pick and extract dominant colors from uploaded images with HEX, RGB, and HSL color codes.
tool_image_resize_desc: Free online image resizer. Resize images to any custom width and height, with aspect ratio lock and support for multiple output formats.
tool_uuid_desc: Free online UUID generator. Generate universally unique identifiers in v1, v4, and v5 formats. Bulk generation with one-click copy.
tool_nanoid_desc: Free online NanoID generator. Create short, unique, URL-friendly identifiers with customizable length and alphabet. Faster and safer than UUID.
tool_qr_code_desc: Free online QR code generator. Create QR codes from text, URLs, emails, phone numbers, and WiFi credentials. Download as PNG or SVG.
tool_password_desc: Free online secure password generator. Create strong random passwords with customizable length, uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols.
tool_lorem_ipsum_desc: Free online Lorem Ipsum generator. Create placeholder text for web design and mockups with customizable paragraph count and word limits.
tool_random_number_desc: Free online random number generator. Generate random integers or decimals within a custom range with options for duplicates and sorting.
tool_barcode_desc: Free online barcode generator. Create CODE128, EAN-13, UPC, and other barcode formats for product labeling and inventory management.
tool_fake_data_desc: Free online fake data generator. Generate realistic mock data including names, emails, addresses, phone numbers, and credit cards for testing.
tool_json_format_desc: Free online JSON formatter, validator and beautifier. Format messy JSON with syntax highlighting, error detection, and one-click minification.
tool_json_visual_desc: Free online JSON visualizer. Explore JSON data as an interactive, collapsible tree view with search, path display, and node highlighting.
tool_sql_format_desc: Free online SQL formatter and beautifier. Format messy SQL queries with proper indentation, keyword highlighting, and syntax validation.
tool_code_format_desc: Free online code formatter. Beautify and format code in JavaScript, Python, HTML, CSS, and many other languages with Prettier integration.
tool_xml_format_desc: Free online XML formatter and validator. Beautify XML documents with proper indentation, tag highlighting, and well-formedness error checking.
tool_csv_viewer_desc: Free online CSV viewer and editor. Open, view, search, filter, and edit CSV files in a spreadsheet-like table with sorting and export.
tool_code_compare_desc: Free online code comparison tool. Compare two code snippets or files side by side with highlighted differences and line-by-line diff view.
tool_text_diff_desc: Free online text diff checker. Compare two texts to find added, removed, and changed lines with color-coded inline and unified diff output.
tool_hash_desc: Free online hash generator. Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, and other hash digests from any text or file input instantly.
tool_base64_encrypt_desc: Free online Base64 encryption tool. Encode sensitive data with Base64 cipher and decode it back. Simple obfuscation for quick data masking.
tool_aes_desc: Free online AES encryption and decryption tool. Secure your data with AES-128, AES-192, or AES-256 using CBC or ECB mode with custom keys.
tool_rsa_desc: Free online RSA encryption and decryption tool. Generate RSA key pairs and encrypt or decrypt text using public-key cryptography in your browser.
tool_url_signature_desc: Free online URL signature generator. Create and verify signed URLs with HMAC for secure API authentication and tamper-proof links.
tool_hmac_desc: Free online HMAC calculator. Generate HMAC signatures using SHA-256, SHA-1, or MD5 for message authentication and API request signing.
tool_chart_basic_desc: Free online chart maker. Create beautiful bar charts, line charts, and pie charts from your data with customizable colors and labels. Download as PNG.
tool_chart_advanced_desc: Free online advanced chart creator. Build complex chart types including radar, funnel, and gauge charts with custom styling and interactive tooltips.
tool_flowchart_desc: Free online flowchart maker. Design professional flowcharts and process diagrams with drag-and-drop shapes, connectors, and auto-layout. Export as PNG or SVG.
tool_mind_map_desc: Free online mind map creator. Create, organize, and visualize ideas with interactive node-based mind maps. Expand, collapse, and export easily.
tool_gantt_desc: Free online Gantt chart maker. Plan project timelines, set task dependencies, track progress, and visualize schedules with interactive Gantt charts.
tool_word_cloud_desc: Free online word cloud generator. Create beautiful word clouds from any text with customizable colors, fonts, shapes, and word count limits.
tool_relation_desc: Free online relationship graph visualizer. Map and visualize complex relationships, connections, and networks between entities with interactive node graphs.
tool_dashboard_desc: Free online dashboard builder. Create interactive dashboards with gauges, charts, and KPI widgets. Customize layouts and monitor metrics visually.
tool_tree_map_desc: Free online treemap generator. Visualize hierarchical data as nested rectangles with proportional sizing. Great for budget, disk usage, and category analysis.
tool_scatter_desc: Free online scatter plot maker. Create scatter plots and XY charts for data analysis, correlation visualization, and trend identification with custom labels.
tool_area_chart_desc: Free online area chart generator. Create stacked and layered area charts to visualize trends, cumulative totals, and data changes over time.
tool_realtime_chart_desc: Free online real-time chart tool. Create live-updating charts with streaming data, auto-scroll, and configurable refresh intervals for monitoring.
tool_regex_desc: Free online regex tester and debugger. Test regular expressions in real-time with match highlighting, group capture, and a comprehensive cheat sheet.
tool_css_gradient_desc: Free online CSS gradient generator. Design linear and radial gradients visually with multiple color stops. Copy ready-to-use CSS code instantly.
tool_color_picker_test_desc: Free online color picker and converter. Pick any color and convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, and HSV formats. Includes palette generation and contrast checker.
tool_performance_desc: Free online JavaScript performance benchmark tool. Measure and compare code execution speed with detailed timing results and statistical analysis.

about_description: Learn about UseEasyTool - your free online tools platform for developers and designers.
about_mission_text: UseEasyTool was created with a simple goal: to provide free, accessible, and powerful online tools for developers, designers, and everyday users. We believe that essential utilities should be available to everyone without requiring software installation or account registration.
about_what_text: Our platform features over 60 carefully crafted tools across 8 categories:
about_feature_1: Converters - Base64, URL, JSON/YAML, Markdown/HTML, and more
about_feature_2: Calculators - Standard, scientific, BMI, loan, and password strength
about_feature_3: Image Tools - Compress, resize, convert formats, filters, and color palettes
about_feature_4: Generators - QR codes, passwords, UUIDs, lorem ipsum, and fake data
about_feature_5: Formatters - JSON, SQL, XML, code formatting, and diff tools
about_feature_6: Crypto - Hash, AES, RSA, HMAC, and URL signatures
about_feature_7: Charts - Bar, line, pie, flowcharts, mind maps, and dashboards
about_feature_8: Testers - Regex, color picker, CSS gradient, and performance tools
about_privacy_text: All our tools run entirely in your browser. We never upload your data to any server. Your files, text, and calculations stay on your device, ensuring complete privacy and security.
about_open_source_text: UseEasyTool is built with modern web technologies and is open source. We welcome contributions from the community to make our tools even better.
about_contact_text: Have suggestions or found a bug? We'd love to hear from you. Visit our Contact page to reach out.
privacy_description: Privacy Policy for UseEasyTool - Learn how we protect your data and privacy.
privacy_overview_text: At UseEasyTool, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle information when you use our website and tools.
privacy_data_processing_text: All our tools process data locally in your browser. We do not upload, store, or transmit your files, text, or any data you input into our tools to any server. Your data never leaves your device.
privacy_cookies_text: We use browser local storage to remember your preferences (such as language and theme settings). These are stored locally on your device and are not transmitted to our servers.
privacy_analytics_text: We may use basic analytics to understand how visitors use our website. This information is anonymous and does not identify individual users.
privacy_ads_text: We may display advertisements on our website. Third-party ad networks may use cookies to serve relevant ads. You can control cookie settings through your browser.
privacy_security_text: We implement appropriate security measures to protect our website. However, since all tool processing happens in your browser, the security of your data is primarily under your control.
privacy_changes_text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
privacy_contact_text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please visit our Contact page.

terms_use_text: UseEasyTool provides free online tools for personal and commercial use. You may use our tools to process your own data, create content, and perform calculations. All tool processing happens locally in your browser.
terms_restriction_1: Use our tools for any illegal purpose
terms_restriction_2: Attempt to interfere with or disrupt our services
terms_restriction_3: Use automated systems to access our tools excessively
terms_restriction_4: Remove or alter any copyright notices
terms_ip_text: The UseEasyTool website, including its design, code, and content, is protected by copyright and other intellectual property laws. You may not copy, modify, or distribute our website without permission.
terms_disclaimer_text: Our tools are provided 'as is' without any warranties. While we strive for accuracy, we cannot guarantee that our tools are error-free or suitable for your specific needs. Use at your own risk.
terms_limitation_text: UseEasyTool shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of our services.
terms_changes_text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
terms_contact_text: For questions about these Terms of Service, please visit our Contact page.
contact_description: Contact UseEasyTool - Get in touch with us for feedback, suggestions, or support.
contact_intro: We'd love to hear from you! Whether you have a question, suggestion, or found a bug, feel free to reach out.
contact_feedback_text: Have a tool suggestion? Let us know!
contact_feedback_note: We read every message and appreciate your input.
contact_response_text: We typically respond to inquiries within 24-48 hours. For bug reports, please include as much detail as possible to help us resolve the issue quickly.
contact_faq_1_a: Yes! All our tools are completely free to use. No registration or payment required.
contact_faq_2_a: Absolutely. All processing happens in your browser. We never upload or store your data on our servers.
contact_faq_3_q: Can I suggest a new tool?
contact_faq_3_a: Yes! We welcome suggestions. Send us an email or open an issue on GitHub.

custom_faq1_q: What if my tool idea is simple?
custom_faq1_a: Simple tools are welcome! Even a $5 contribution helps cover our time. We'll add useful tools to the platform for everyone.
custom_faq2_a: Typically 1-2 weeks for simple tools, longer for complex ones. We'll email you with updates if you provide your email.
custom_faq3_a: You can still submit your idea! Select the smallest amount or $0. We prioritize paid requests but consider all suggestions.
custom_faq4_a: Yes, custom tools are added to UseEasyTool for everyone to use. If you need a private tool, mention it in your request.
